name: Copern McRooney
source: Horai's publisher from the online comedy website, Macked. He seems to have little faith when it comes to Horai's ability to write decent stories for Macked, but for whatever reason, he still pays Horai all the same. Though his age is not entirely known, he seems to hate being called "old".
